official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Building regulations approval is separate from planning permission and a project may require both.

official_measurement_examples.name: Full plans timetable
official_measurement_examples.fact: For non-higher-risk work GOV.UK states full plans decisions are generally expected within 5 weeks or 2 months with consent; this is not planning determination time.

official_measurement_examples.name: Building notice distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: A building notice route can allow smaller work to start after notice but does not provide the same formal advance approval as full plans.

official_measurement_examples.name: Regularisation distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Regularisation is retrospective building-control approval for eligible historic work and is not retrospective planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Higher-risk approval
official_measurement_examples.fact: Higher-risk building work requires Building Safety Regulator approval before relevant work starts unless an exception applies.

official_measurement_examples.name: Higher-risk threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current guidance uses at least 7 storeys or 18 metres plus the specified residential/hospital/care-home criteria; height alone must not be treated as the full test.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 currentity
official_measurement_examples.fact: The BSR application-data collection was updated in July 2026 and includes April-June 2026 performance data.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Building-control approval or a completion certificate does not establish land ownership planning permission infrastructure capacity or development yield.

core_rules: building regulations approval is not planning permission
planning permission is not building regulations approval
full plans decision time is not planning decision time
building notice is not full plans approval
regularisation is not retrospective planning permission
higher-risk threshold requires full statutory criteria
BSR approval is not land-title evidence
approved documents are guidance not site compliance certificates
completion certificate is not planning discharge
future Building Safety Levy date must not be treated as current before commencement
application statistics do not predict parcel approval
building control does not establish ownership
building control does not calculate development yield
no parcel building-control clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
